description: This file defines hardware timing constants, configuration, and inline functions for the nRF52810 radio hardware in a Bluetooth controller implementation, including timing delays, power levels, and errata workarounds.

methods.name: hal_radio_reset
methods.description: Resets the radio hardware, applying errata workarounds if necessary.

methods.name: hal_radio_stop
methods.description: Placeholder for stopping radio operations, cleanup if needed.

methods.name: hal_radio_ram_prio_setup
methods.description: Configures RAM priority for various radio modules.

methods.name: hal_radio_phy_mode_get
methods.description: Returns the radio PHY mode based on input parameters.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_power_floor
methods.description: Determines the closest supported transmit power level at or below the input level.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_ready_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns the delay in microseconds for radio TX readiness based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_ready_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns the delay in microseconds for radio RX readiness based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_chain_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns the chain delay in microseconds for TX.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_chain_delay_us_get
methods.description: Returns the chain delay in microseconds for RX based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_ready_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns the delay in nanoseconds for radio TX readiness based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_ready_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns the delay in nanoseconds for radio RX readiness based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_chain_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns the chain delay in nanoseconds for TX based on PHY.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_chain_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Returns the chain delay in nanoseconds for RX based on PHY.
